overview_description.description:
TeamOut provides an online platform to assist remote teams in finding the ideal offsite location. It handles everything from venue selection to transportation and activities.

The company was founded in 2021 and is based in San Francisco, California.

about_short_description.short_description: TeamOut is the platform that makes retreat planning easy for remote teams.

product.name: Venue Sourcing Platform
product.description: A platform that helps companies discover and book venues for corporate retreats and offsite events, offering a large catalog of vetted properties and negotiated rates.

product.name: Retreat Planning Service
product.description: A service offering end-to-end planning support for corporate retreats, including itinerary design, vendor coordination, and attendee management.

product.name: Corporate Retreat Packages
product.description: Pre-designed retreat packages that bundle venue, activities, catering, and transportation for streamlined corporate event planning.

product.name: Event Space Rental Service
product.description: A service providing access to a variety of event spaces suitable for corporate parties, meetings, and receptions.

product.name: Activity Coordination Service
product.description: A service that sources and arranges team-building activities, workshops, and outdoor adventures near event venues.

product.name: Transportation Coordination Service
product.description: A service managing group transportation logistics including shuttles, limousines, and boats for corporate events.
